content: Excuse me, could you tell me whether there is a restaurant near here?
Yes, there is one at Sanyuan Bridge. It is a famous restaurant in the city.
I'm afraid there must be a lot of people there.
I think so. I think you'd better make a phone call to see whether there is a table available.
But we don't know the telephone number.
Here is a tourist guidebook. You can look it up in the book.
You are so kind! Thank you very much.
